description: The plans of one site and window side by side (docs/adr/0024), in the order of ids.

items.description: One plan of a comparison, exactly as stored (nothing is recomputed).

scenario.description: The plan's what-if label; absent when it carries none.

status.description: The plan's status as stored (SUPERSEDED, docs/adr/0024 decision 3, is additive).

path_id.description: The ProcessPath the plan evaluates (scenarios may evaluate different paths).

assigned_demand.description: Orders the plan was evaluated against.

labour_requirement.description: The ADR 0022 labour requirement per path step, as stored (never null).

items.description: Additive (docs/adr/0022). The labour one step of the plan's path requires: tasks x the engineered standard seconds of the step's task type (labor-performance's standard in force for the plan's site at the window start; a step's process type names its task type). Computed when the plan was created and stored with it: a later revision of a standard never rewrites it. Informational: the ORDER shortage, the bottleneck and every published event do not depend on it. When known is false the figures are 0 and reason says why.

standard_seconds.description: expected_seconds of the standard in force; 0 when there is none.

standard_site_scoped.description: True when that standard is scoped to the plan's site rather than every site.

tasks.description: Tasks the step's demand is (released lines for PICK with demand_source orders, else assigned_demand x tasks_per_order[step]).

required_average_heads.description: required_labour_hours over the plan window length, in people.

reason.description: Present only when known is false. no-labor-standard: no labor-performance standard of the step's task type is in force for the plan's site and window (or the step is not a task type it measures, e.g. REBIN). no-task-factor: a standard exists but the step's tasks cannot be counted (no tasks_per_order factor).
